title: Week 1: Getting Set Up
text:
I hope to learn how to use R and spatial data analysis more effectively in this course. I want to develop practical skills that I can apply to urban planning projects. I am a little nervous about coding because I do not have much experience with it, but I hope to become more comfortable with practice.
Set up the portfolio workflow: made a repository from a template, cloned it with GitHub Desktop, edited files in RStudio, rendered with Quarto, and published to GitHub Pages.

title: Home
text:
Welcome to my portfolio for MUSA 5080: Public Policy Analytics at the University of Pennsylvania.
This site documents my work in the Master of Urban Spatial Analytics program — weekly notes, course assignments, and a final project applying data analysis to urban policy questions.



I’m a student in the MUSA program at Penn. My background is Finance at OSU, and I’m interested in data science.




Weekly Notes — what I’m learning each week
Assignments — analyses completed for the course
About — more background and how to reach me
